claims: Current decomp shows VA 0x25a1d0 passed into FUN_0015b280 as part of the function 00173938 menu/UI initialization, while the recovered FUN_0015b280 body provides no CARS PTG-loader/parser edge.
The fresh source evidence does not establish that LIVERY `.ptg;1` files are loaded, parsed, or drawn by the CARS reward callback.
FUN_0021fd50 sets selectors 10 and 11 to 1 for param_13==0 and 2 otherwise; `FUN_00220d60` writes selector-dependent GS state but no ALPHA_1 write.

FUN_0021fd50 halves packed supplied vertex-color channels by `(component+1)>>1`, but the fresh decomp call from 00220678 lists only six arguments to a function decompiled with 13 parameters, so that excerpt does not identify final reward-button texture-alpha/blend semantics.
The current evidence still does not prove game-exact display alpha/composition for recovered PTGs.
